test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the name of the sacred text of Christianity which consists of two parts: the Old Testament which is essentially the Hebrew text of the time of Jesus: And the New Testament that includes writings about Jesus Christ and the early church?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bible**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Bible** is the sacred text of **Christianity**.
 
• It consists of two main parts: the **Old Testament** and the **New Testament**.
